notes.note: 2026-09-24 09:3xZ ops-triage: MEASURED THE MISSING NUMBER -- discovery is ZERO, and the pipeline's levers cannot change that. Instagram's account-level insights answer reach with breakdown=follow_type (probed live read-only this pass: reach=6, FOLLOWER=6, and NO NON_FOLLOWER row; media-level reach rejects the breakdown, account-level accepts it). That number is now collected with every follower snapshot: growth_snapshots 1051 (09-24 05:36Z) = followers 157, follower_reach 6, non_follower_reach 0, reach_total 6, profile_views 0. So nothing outside the follower list is being shown these posts at all -- a DISTRIBUTION ceiling stated by the platform, not inferred from per-post sums, and 0 profile visits means no funnel step from reach to a follow either. Supporting cadence measurement (DB, weekly, insights-bearing posts): total weekly reach 139-149 at 23-42 posts/week vs 36 at 3 posts, while per-post reach is 12.0 at 3 posts and 3.1-3.3 at 13-42 -- i.e. volume spreads a ~150/week ceiling across more posts without adding reach or a single follower (followers 150->157 over 08-26..09-14, then flat at 157 for 10 days). DECISION (mine, recorded here rather than deferred): (1) the growth thesis's mechanism -- publish -> discovery -> follows -- has no discovery step on this account, so no content/caption/hashtag/cadence edit can move followers; those levers are measured INERT, and cadence is left at the configured cap (raising it is the one change the data says is actively harmful to per-post visibility). (2) The pre-registered follower leg is already DETERMINISTICALLY failed (157 vs the 170 ceiling; it needs +13 in the 11 days to the 10-05 read at an achieved 0.07/day), and the 10-05 engagement leg will now read on a valid cohort (5/5 feasible, gate-cohort-starved), so the 10-05 read cannot be :go or :continue and the gate's own pivot candidate is what fires. (3) PIVOT PRE-REGISTERED (before any build, per the gate discipline): the discovery arm is REELS/MOTION cut from renders we already produce -- the one organic Instagram surface with non-follower distribution, publishable on the SAME account and API (media_type=REELS) with no credential or platform change, so it is NOT a Tim ask. Its success metric is the account-level non_follower_reach now collected on every snapshot (self-closing criterion: non_follower_reach > 0), NOT engagement -- engagement is the wrong read for an account with no discovery. This item stays OPEN as the gate's continuously-tracked acceptance counter and self-closes on the first engaged post.

The still path is provably unchanged (media_type is sent only when it differs from the default). DELIBERATELY NOT ARMED, and the sequencing is the decision rather than an omission: Growth::GateRead#cohort_size counts posts published inside the review window that join a photo AND carry collected insights, so publishing a NEW FORMAT into the window the pre-registered read measures would inject an uncontrolled variable into that read own cohort -- the arm waits for the 2026-10-05 13:00Z read it was sequenced after. Its own live run caught its first false positive (the client NAMES ReelBuilder in prose; the scan now strips Ruby comments). ITEM STAYS OPEN: it is the gate continuously-tracked acceptance counter and self-closes on the first engaged published post. Metric for the arm remains the collected non_follower_reach (latest measured 0), NOT engagement.

This pass closed a MONITORING gap that sat directly under this item's own premise (the hashtags are 'the account's only discoverability lever at 157 followers'): nothing measured whether that lever actually SHIPPED. The tags are appended to a local variable at send time (packs/scheduling/lib/tasks/scheduled_posting.rake: published_caption = post.caption + Array(post.hashtags).join(' ')) and never persisted, so scheduling_posts.caption does NOT contain them and the local DB cannot tell a tagged send from an untagged one -- the same blind spot under which all 197 posted items shipped with zero tags for the account's whole life. FIX (this commit): new probe check check_published_hashtags_shipped + pure hashtag_shipped_verdict reads the PUBLISHED CAPTION BACK FROM INSTAGRAM (media node field caption) and counts the column's tags inside it; an unreadable media is UNKNOWN (never a failure) and only a caption containing NONE of a non-empty column's tags fires. VERIFIED with ground truth, not bookkeeping: readback on posts 331/323/339/330 -> column_tags=10 shipped_tags=10 for each (the caption tail carries all ten, e.g. '#lifestyleblogger ... #tinyjoys'). The check is not vacuous: the identical rails script with each column tag mangled ('#food' -> '#foodzz') returned shipped_tags=0 for the same three posts and hashtag_shipped_verdict fired warn naming ids 331/323/339; healthy path returns None. selftest 625 assertions 0 failures (was 614); checks-audit 56 checks 2 firing 0 raised 0 unreadable (was 55). Also verified this pass, and NOT a defect: the producer is pillar-targeted now -- future queue rows carry #food #cooking #dining / #fashion #style / #travel #adventure according to photo.content_pillar, with the constant brand-tag set confined to 3 pre-fix rows (posts 324/332/333, created 09-17, publishing 09-25/09-26) that QueuedHashtagBackfill will not rewrite by design (it fills only EMPTY columns); accepted as a bounded 2-day tail rather than editing queued public content.
